text:
ana-sales: SilverStream POC started. They reported p95 first-token ~800ms and random 503s during quick demo ramp to 60 concurrent. Can eng swarm? cc @leo-eng @mira-sre @olivia-solutions
leo-eng: what's their request pattern? small prompts? streaming? any sample id?
ana-sales: they said inputs tiny (~8 tokens), streaming=true, they fan out 3x per user. trace id ss-20240502-11:07:25. header snippet:
--hdr--
X-Request-Id: ss-20240502-11:07:25
X-Rate-Limit-Limit: 2500
X-Rate-Limit-Remaining: 12
User-Agent: SilverStream/0.9
--end--

mira-sre: checking infra: quick spike on shard gpu-pool-7 at 11:07:27. Logs:
[2024-05-02T11:07:27Z] WARN batching: batch_size 64 > target 20ms, flushed early
[2024-05-02T11:07:27Z] ERROR serve: queue timeout 90s shard=7 req=ss-20240502-11:07:25 status=503

mira-sre: prefix cache miss_rate ~70% during spike; high-cardinality prefix churn due to many tiny, unique prompts.
leo-eng: likely cause: bursty parallelism causing big batches which increase TTFT for small inputs and evict cache entries. Quick mitigations: server-side caps (max_batch_size 18, batch_window_ms 10), enable single_item_fastpath for <24 token requests, and set short-lived prefix caching (ttl 30s) for common prefixes.
olivia-solutions: customer doesn't want client changes for demo. can we apply server-side tweaks immediately?
tom-support: yes, can stage a route patch to a test route.
deploy-bot: Route update queued: sales/silverstream-poc -> max_batch_size=18, batch_window_ms=10, single_item_fastpath=true, prefix_cache_ttl=30s. Applying in 20s.
mira-sre: after change median TTFT fell from 380ms -> 140ms within 30s, p95 down to ~260ms, 503s stopped. still seeing occasional 429s during the sharpest bursts.
leo-eng: for 429s, check if they hit per-account rate limits vs global. If they need burst capacity for demo we can provision temporary burst credits or suggest a small Dedicated reserve during the pilot.
olivia-solutions: prepare an estimate for a 7-day burst buffer + optional 1-month Dedicated trial. I'll draft.
sec-arya: security ask: SilverStream requested KMS key isolation and an allowlist template. I'll send SOC2 summary and a short KMS diagram; need their security contact info to complete questionnaire.
ana-sales: I'll get their sec contact and push questionnaire. they also asked if Redwood can prefill prefix cache for their top 25 prefixes to avoid warmup churn.
mira-sre: we can prefill route-level prefix cache if they provide the list; that should reduce miss_rate significantly during demo ramps. Also we can spin up an extra ephemeral worker shard for 5 minutes during the demo to absorb spikes (manual bump).
leo-eng: follow-ups: (1) Olivia to send quote with 7-day burst concession (2) Ana to gather prefixes + sec contact (3) Sec to send docs (4) Mira to monitor 30 minutes and report metrics.
ana-sales: scheduled a 15m ramp with customer in 10m, will report results here. thanks team :thumbsup:
